GitHub's self-service pack is **SOC 3**, not the confidential SOC 2 Type 2.
Hetzner does not issue SOC 2; ISO 27001 + BSI C5 is their stated substitute.
Cloudflare SOC 2 Type 2 is still dashboard-only (Super Admin).
